entities.title: Platform layer
entities.summary: A model of the ZX Spectrum for this game's look: the display, its own font, one-key-at-a-time input and beeper sound.
entities.purpose: Gives the UI a 256×192 bitmap with a 32×24 grid of INK, PAPER, BRIGHT and FLASH attributes and a border, rendered to RGBA as a pure function and shown on a canvas; reads the keyboard, the touch keypad and taps one key per prompt; and plays square-wave notes, rests and noise.
boundaries: Knows nothing of the game: which keys mean what is the engine's (RULES §15.1), what is drawn is the UI's.
Keys it reserves (M, for sound) never reach a prompt.
